tei:div.tei:p: When our forefathers trusted in the name of God, my Creator, they rose and prospered, and also saw the fruits of their works; but since they were seduced from him, and walked contrary unto him, they have gone on decreasing until the tenth month.

On the tenth of the month the King of Babylon advanced to
wards the holy city, and besieged it, and his general,Nebusaradon. the great destroyer, approached, and I was given up to destruction. I was afflicted with fetters, and therefore my harp is this month turned into mourning. (When, &c.)When our forefathers trusted in the name of God, my Creator, they rose and prospered, and also saw the fruits of their works; but since they were seduced from him, and walked contrary unto him, they have gone on decreasing until the tenth month.

Israel, once designated as the firstborn, became the chief of those to be destroyed. He mentioned the names of other gods, and this sin caused misfortune. He did not acknowledge the Almighty, and for that he was swept away by the storm. He was seized with travails as a woman who bringeth forth her first child. what time thou didst lift up thyself on high. (When, &c.)When our forefathers trusted in the name of God, my Creator, they rose and prospered, and also saw the fruits of their works; but since they were seduced from him, and walked contrary unto him, they have gone on decreasing until the tenth month.

The Lord brought the day of calamity and siege; he commanded my enemies round about me to destroy my babes. On that day my heart fainted. and I had no strength left when he said unto the prophet,Ezek. xxiv. 3. “Utter a parable unto the rebellious house.” (When, &c.)When our forefathers trusted in the name of God, my Creator, they rose and prospered, and also saw the fruits of their works; but since they were seduced from him, and walked contrary unto him, they have gone on decreasing until the tenth month.

He stripped the judges in the gates of their robes; his wrath burnt like fire, and he deprived us of our crown, and cast down the beauty of the wood of Lebanon, and from a windy storm and tempest the hair of my flesh stood up. (When, &c.)When our forefathers trusted in the name of God, my Creator, they rose and prospered, and also saw the fruits of their works; but since they were seduced from him, and walked contrary unto him, they have gone on decreasing until the tenth month.

Formerly thou wert likened to the most beautiful, O Israel, and now thou art mournful, because of the iniquity by which thou hast stumbled, and thereby thy heart hath turned back. The enemy attacked thee in the back, and thou wast weakened, the first and the second time, and thy wound was not bound up, not the least balm was administered to thee. (When, &c.)When our forefathers trusted in the name of God, my Creator, they rose and prospered, and also saw the fruits of their works; but since they were seduced from him, and walked contrary unto him, they have gone on decreasing until the tenth month.

The Righteous, the Rock, who is perfect, was weary to bear with our iniquities; from the cherub on the holy ark he flew first to the threshold of the temple, and then to the corner of the roof, because of the sins which stain Israel, whose cry rose to him; yea, their wickedness increased as a tree that yieldeth fruit. (When, &c.)When our forefathers trusted in the name of God, my Creator, they rose and prospered, and also saw the fruits of their works; but since they were seduced from him, and walked contrary unto him, they have gone on decreasing until the tenth month.

He who counteth deeds, hardeneth all my adversaries; for I spent my days in misdeeds, and as a disgrace to my youth, I forgot the benefits of him who fed and clothed me. (When, &c.)When our forefathers trusted in the name of God, my Creator, they rose and prospered, and also saw the fruits of their works; but since they were seduced from him, and walked contrary unto him, they have gone on decreasing until the tenth month.

My adversaries opened their mouths and swallowed mine inheritance, they prevailed against me, and drank and sucked my blood; heathen besieged me, and ill-treated my brethren. “Rase it, rase it!” exclaimed the sons of Seir and Hori. (When, &c.)When our forefathers trusted in the name of God, my Creator, they rose and prospered, and also saw the fruits of their works; but since they were seduced from him, and walked contrary unto him, they have gone on decreasing until the tenth month.

They said, “Come, and let us consume them, that their memory may cease.” O jealous and
avenging God, reward them, let them expiate their destruction; reward them according to their deeds, and let them be ashamed of their hope, even as Pharaoh’s baker, who dreamt of the three white baskets. (When, &c.)When our forefathers trusted in the name of God, my Creator, they rose and prospered, and also saw the fruits of their works; but since they were seduced from him, and walked contrary unto him, they have gone on decreasing until the tenth month.

My wounds and murderous bruises have not been mollified, and mine eye which looketh toward the Lord is darkened. Is his wrath not yet appeased? Is it to endure for ever? Why hath he done so, and why this anger? (When, &c.)When our forefathers trusted in the name of God, my Creator, they rose and prospered, and also saw the fruits of their works; but since they were seduced from him, and walked contrary unto him, they have gone on decreasing until the tenth month.

O merciful God, do not forsake me for ever; the days of my mourning have been greatly prolonged, and still my heart is sighing; return, O Lord, unto my tent, and forsake no more thy dwelling; reward me for the days of my mourning when thou comest to appoint my wages. (When, &c.&c.)When our forefathers trusted in the name of God, my Creator, they rose and prospered, and also saw the fruits of their works; but since they were seduced from him, and walked contrary unto him, they have gone on decreasing until the tenth month.

O Lord, my portion! hasten to be my help; divest me of my sackcloth, and gird me with joy; enlighten my darkness, and let thy light shine upon the night of my pleasure, for thou art my light. (When, &c.)When our forefathers trusted in the name of God, my Creator, they rose and prospered, and also saw the fruits of their works; but since they were seduced from him, and walked contrary unto him, they have gone on decreasing until the tenth month.

Redeem, O Lord, my soul from sorrow and sighing; procure relief for thy people. my king and holy one. Turn into release the fast of the fifth month, and into joy and delight the fast of the fourth and of the tenth month.
